PRIZES AND ODDS

During the hourly drawing1, twenty numbers2 between 1 and 60 are drawn. Prizes3 and odds vary depending upon number of counts selected.

Hi-Lo Count	Prize	Odds
0-4, 16-20	$555	1 in 929.3
5, 15	$115	1 in 189.6
6, 14	$30	1 in 48.5
7, 13	$10	1 in 17.2
8, 12	$5	1 in 8.3
9, 11	$3	1 in 5.4
10, 10	$3	1 in 5.4
Overall odds of winning a prize varies upon number of counts selected.

DISCLAIMERS:

1 Hi-Lo can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week, with the first draw time at 4:10 AM and the last drawing at 11:10 PM Arizona time.

2 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

3 $55,500, prize would be pari-mutuel when the total prize for base top prize with 5X multiplier drawn is $55,500. The prize amount per winner would be recalculated when the total prize top prize with 5X multiplier is $55,500. The total prize will be split into equal shares, one share for each $1.00 played. The prize amount per share is, $55,500 divided by total winning bets. The prize amount per winner is, the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

4 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
HI-LO
Step 1,
Pick Your Hi-Lo Count

Choose Quick Pick or manually select the number of occurrences of High and Low number you think will be drawn. Twenty numbers will be selected from a pool of sixty numbers(1 - 60); low numbers are 1 – 30 and high numbers are 31 – 60.

Choose Quick Pick and let the computer select the Hi-Lo Count for you, or select your own Hi-Lo Count from the following 13 options:

0-4 Hi - 16-20 Lo
8 Hi - 12 Lo
12 Hi - 8 Lo
5 Hi - 15 Lo
9 Hi - 11 Lo
13 Hi - 7 Lo
6 Hi - 14 Lo
10 Hi - 10 Lo
14 Hi - 6 Lo
7 Hi - 13 Lo
11 Hi - 9 Lo
15 Hi -  5 Lo
16-20 Hi - 0-4 Lo
Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Select your wager - $1, $2, $5, $10 or $20 per play. You also have the option to add Super Bonus to multiply your prize up to 5X.

Your ticket will print with your Hi-Lo Count on it.

Quick Draw tickets can be purchased at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the Hi-Lo Count on your ticket to the Hi-Lo Count drawn to win.
